card.title: Nintendo Switch charging port and power issues guide with capacitor identification

source.title: Nintendo Switch video filter and capacitor identification

symptoms: Switch recognized while docked but then you don't see image

claims.statement: Red box on left 100nF x 2 for marked CAPS - 0201
claims.evidence: Annotated board photo with red boxes on capacitors

claims.statement: They smooth the signal between the power rails and VBUS and if you get the Switch recognized while docked but then you don't see image, they are probably the issue
claims.evidence: Text description next to the board photo

cautions: Third-party docks can cause charging ports to fail or brick consoles
Use of any USB-C cable that isn't the one included with the console, the pro controller, or the Joycon charging grip can result in permanent damage or a slower charging cycle
card.caveats: Exact schematic pinout and precise circuit diagram are not fully displayed.
